# Geeky Gadgets

> Geeky Gadgets curates deals and discounts on software, hardware, AI tools, and refurbished computers from top brands.

The site specializes in aggregating technology deals across software licenses (Microsoft Visual Studio, Windows 11 Pro, Microsoft 365), AI tools (VoiceType AI, ChatPlayground AI), and discounted hardware including refurbished laptops and desktops from Dell, Lenovo, and Apple.
